name: ADHD Tab Manager
shortDescription: Declutter your browser and stay focused. Save sessions, block distractions, and track focus with a Pomodoro timer.
firefoxSummary: A tab manager designed for ADHD brains — save and restore tab sessions, block distracting sites during focus mode, and track focus with a Pomodoro timer. Works in the side panel on Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
description:
ADHD Tab Manager is a tab manager designed for ADHD brains - minimal clutter, one action at a time, and dopamine-friendly feedback. It opens in the browser side panel on Chrome, Edge and Firefox, so your tabs stay reachable without losing your place. On Safari it runs as a classic popup.

Home: a live list of every open tab grouped by window, with per-window close actions, undo-close that restores tabs at their original index (up to 20), and a daily Tao Te Ching quote with chapter and verse.

Focus Mode: hide every open tab behind a calm focus screen, block distracting sites while focus is on (blocked sites redirect to a local interstitial - no remote calls), and get a summary of minutes focused and distractions blocked when you finish. Wildcard-friendly: block reddit.com and www/old/mobile subdomains are covered too.

Sessions: save the tabs of one window, a chosen set of windows, or all windows as a named session with an icon. Restore instantly - pinned tabs come back pinned, in order. 50-session cap, delete with a 5-second undo.

Pomodoro Timer: 25/5/15 classic pomodoro with skip, reset, pause/resume. The background worker keeps the timer accurate even with the panel closed and fires a notification when a session completes. Custom ranges: work 1-120, short break 1-30, long break 1-60. Daily streak counter.

Quick Actions: close all tabs with a confirmation dialog; every close is undoable.

Export/Import: one-click JSON backup and restore with aggressive validation - malformed or hostile files are rejected atomically.

Design: clean, rounded, ADHD-friendly UI, light and dark themes with zero flash, keyboard navigation, responsive from 360px to wide panels.

Open Source: 100% free, MIT-licensed, code on GitHub. Donate with crypto (ETH/USDC/USDT + SOL) via the in-app Donate card.

Privacy: no data is collected. Everything runs locally - no accounts, no analytics, no tracking, no remote servers.
